title: For animals left behind, Biyaya is a blessing
summary: As of June 2026, Biyaya had helped 7,696 cats and dogs since 2022, while 629 had been rehomed and delivered to their forever homes, according to figures presented at the sanctuary in Alfonso, Cavite.
